ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B3-2,
Community Shopping District, symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 4-J in the
area bound by:

The alley next east of and parallel to South Hamlin Avenue; a line 100 feet north of and
parallel to West 16" Street; South Ridgeway Avenue; a line 60.14 feet north of and
parallel to West 16" Street; the alley next east of and parallel to South Ridgeway
Avenue; a line 150 feet north of and parallel to West 16" Street; South Lawndale
Avenue; the alley next north of and parallel to West 16" Street; South Millard Avenue; a
line 40.16 feet north of and parallel to West 16" Street; the alley next east of and parallel
to South Millard Avenue; a line 98.89 feet north of and parallel to West 16" Street; South
Central Park Avenue; West 16" Street; South Millard Avenue; a line 35 feet south of and
parallel to West 16" Street; the alley next west of and parallel to South Millard Avenue;
West 16" Street, South Lawndale Avenue; a line 72 feet south of and parallel to West
16" Street; the alley next west of and parallel to South Lawndale Avenue; and West 16"
Street,

to those of a B3-3, Community Shopping District.
